headline: South Africa Responds to Proposed U.S. AGOA Benefits Withdrawal
summary: South Africa acknowledged the U.S. government's intent to withdraw its African Growth and Opportunity Act benefits starting January 2027. Labor unions warned of potential job losses in agriculture and automotive industries.
why: AGOA provides eligible sub-Saharan African nations duty-free access to the U.S. market, making tariff exemptions vital for local export-driven sectors.

impacts.name: South Africa
impacts.why: Removal of trade preferences can affect national export revenues and specific manufacturing and agricultural sectors.
